sources.source: LocatED annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published 16 July 2026; covers performance and expenditure from April 2025 to March 2026 and records the transfer of LocatED activities and staff to the Department for Education on 1 April 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Company activity, property projects, sites, expenditure, transfers and school-place outcomes remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: Published 3 June 2026; reviews law-reform work undertaken from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Projects, consultations, recommendations, government acceptance, legislation and realised legal outcomes remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: The official report covers DWP clinical-governance activity in 2025/26, including responses to Prevention of Future Death reports and internal process reviews.
sources.quality_effect: Referrals, reviews, recommendations, responses, small case counts and claimant health outcomes remain distinct.

sources.source: Trade Remedies Authority annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published 14 July 2026; reports delivery, performance, accountability and financial position for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Applications, investigations, measures, recommendations, trade flows and domestic-industry outcomes remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: The official collection added the 2025 to 2026 annual report on 3 July 2026, covering statutory activity relating to trade unions and employers’ associations.
sources.quality_effect: Organisations, annual returns, complaints, investigations, decisions and non-compliance remain distinct.

sources.source: Independent Adviser on Ministerial Standards Annual Report 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: Published 28 May 2026; covers ministerial interests, Ministerial Code advice and former-minister business appointments from April 2025 to March 2026, including transferred functions after ACOBA closed in October 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Declared interests, advice, referrals, investigations, findings, appointments and misconduct remain distinct.

sources.source: British Business Bank Annual Report and Accounts 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published 21 July 2026; reports performance during 2025/26 and distinguishes public funding, private capital and guaranteed lending.
sources.quality_effect: Commitments, guarantees, finance facilitated, businesses, expected outputs and realised outcomes remain distinct.

sources.source: Pension Protection Fund annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published 9 July 2026; covers activities and finances from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 under the Pensions Act 2004 framework.
sources.quality_effect: Schemes, members, claims, compensation, assets, liabilities and employer insolvencies remain distinct.
